$comment: Release layout — ADR-006 / REQ-LIC-8. The two planes MUST ship as separate downloads. tools/check-artifacts.mjs verifies this, and CI runs it on every push.

artifacts.name: crowddeck-venue
artifacts.summary: The venue layer: scheduler, persistence, API, clients, MIDI interconnect, and a conformant stub engine. Independently useful with any CDEP engine.

artifacts.name: crowddeck-engine
artifacts.summary: The Mixxx-derived headless audio engine and its CDEP server. A standalone executable, independently runnable, and replaceable by any conforming engine (REQ-LIC-4, REQ-LIC-5).
